items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Sun White. Well he live up on Long Street now, I believe. Back real quick. He was playing with them.

ctx.x: He was in the car. He dropped dead from playing a parade up with the-

No, but I'll tell you how it was. Was that Washington? Was that Washington? Fourth and- Let me see, not Fourth. Sixth and St. Thomas. That's where the band was supposed to meet. It was in the summertime. Hot. We were all that on white shirts and black ties and things. And I don't forget what time it was we were supposed to leave there. He was rather late. And so when he came, so when he came, when he came there, he was late. And Brown, Chris Kelly was playing with Brown Band then. And this little fella called,…
I bet you didn't know that.
